text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. This approach helps teams stay focused and know exactly what they need to achieve. It is also important to set milestones, which are key points along the way that show your progress. Deliverables are the actual results or products you must complete, such as a report or a website. Finally, you need stakeholder alignment. This means making sure everyone involved, including your team, managers, and clients, agrees on the goals and understands their role. When everyone is on the same page, projects run more smoothly and are more likely to succeed.
